title: SYNAPSE: Neuro-Symbolic Visual Thought-to-Text Decoding via Topological Semantic Denoising
abstract: arXiv:2605.27790v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent advances in large language models have accelerated open-vocabulary EEG-to-imagined-text decoding, where non-invasive neural activity recorded during visual perception is translated into coherent natural language descriptions of viewed stimuli. However, existing systems remain highly vulnerable to biological noise, where corrupted neural projections induce hallucinated or semantically unstable generation in frozen language models. We introduce SYNAPSE (Symbolic Neural Alignment for Precise Semantic Extraction), a lightweight neuro-symbolic framework that stabilizes neural text generation through inference-time symbolic regularization. By purifying EEG-derived semantic candidates using commonsense graph structure and latent exemplars, SYNAPSE improves semantic stability without end-to-end LLM fine-tuning. translated_title: SYNAPSE：通过拓扑语义去噪实现神经符号的视觉思维到文本解码
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.27790v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：大语言模型的最新进展加速了开放词汇的脑电（EEG）到想象文本的解码，即将视觉感知过程中记录的非侵入性神经活动转换为对所观看刺激的连贯自然语言描述。然而，现有系统仍然极易受到生物噪声的影响，受损的神经投影会在冻结的语言模型中诱发幻觉或语义不稳定的生成。我们提出了SYNAPSE（Symbolic Neural Alignment for Precise Semantic Extraction，用于精确语义提取的符号神经对齐），这是一个轻量级的神经符号框架，通过推理时的符号正则化来稳定神经文本生成。通过利用常识图结构和潜在样本对EEG衍生的语义候选进行净化，SYNAPSE无需进行端到端的大语言模型微调即可提升语义稳定性。在流行的EEG解码基准测试和多个冻结LLM后端上的实验表明，该方法相较于未受约束的基线方法取得了一致的性能提升（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出SYNAPSE，一个轻量级神经符号框架，通过推理时利用常识图谱和潜在样本对EEG语义候选进行拓扑语义去噪，在不微调大语言模型的情况下显著提升脑电到文本解码的语义稳定性。
en_tdlr: SYNAPSE is a lightweight neuro-symbolic framework that stabilizes EEG-to-text decoding through inference-time topological semantic denoising using commonsense graph structures and latent exemplars, achieving consistent gains without end-to-end LLM fine-tuning.
